Container.Name: beyond-notes
Container.Overview: Beyond Notes is a self-hosted home for your notes, daily journal, tasks, wikis, databases and published websites. One container, SQLite by default (Postgres optional). Sign in with a password, a passkey, or single sign-on (OIDC or your reverse proxy). Import from Notion, Obsidian and Evernote.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, uploads, backups and the secrets key. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: The address you use to open Beyond Notes (e.g. https://notes.example.com). Links, single sign-on and passkeys depend on it.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: SQLite inside the Data folder by default. For Postgres: postgres://user:password@host:5432/beyond_notes
